topic.title: Regarding a Title to Be Awarded to the Winner of This Competition

messages.content:
Dear Competition Organizers,

First of all, thank you very much for hosting such a wonderful competition.

Although I had been away from Pokémon for several years, this competition has given me the opportunity to rediscover its appeal. Participating has been an incredibly valuable and enjoyable experience for me.

I would like to ask whether it might be possible to award the winner of this competition an officially recognized, Pokémon-themed title, such as “Pokémon Master” (tentative name).

I believe that many participants in this competition are interested not only in Kaggle but also have a genuine love for Pokémon. For this reason, I thought that awarding a special Pokémon-related title as a symbol of victory would be a great honor for the winner and make the experience of participating in this competition even more memorable.

As for the criteria for being considered a winner, would earning a Kaggle gold medal be appropriate?

I apologize if this suggestion is off the mark, but I would greatly appreciate your consideration.
